📊 Balance Lab

Records real battles played with the normal combat loop. Rogue diagnostics track uptime, damage, resets and ability use.
Auto Balance runs randomized 3v3 AI-vs-AI battles and tracks every exact build separately (ability + ultimate). Captain/racial bonuses are disabled in this test so the result measures the build itself. 5,000 battles gives a quick balance sample; use 10,000 for build stability or 20,000 for the strongest counter/matchup data. The CSV now records team-vs-team results so rock-paper-scissors counters can be measured directly.

🧠 Team Formation

Optional preset strategy. It changes targeting, movement tempo, healing priorities and opening spacing.
Previewing formations

🧠 Team Behavior

Choose how your team should fight. Custom Behavior opens the detailed focus, control and healing orders.
🎯 Who should we focus?
Your DPS pursue this enemy, find range and line of sight, and keep focus until it dies or becomes untargetable. Healing and necessary survival actions keep their own priorities.
🌀 Who should we control?
Hexform and other targeted control prefer this enemy when possible.
💚 Who gets healing priority?
Healers favor this teammate when injured. Critical teammates can still override the order.
⚔️ Switch focus if another enemy is low HP?
Yes: if another enemy drops below 25% HP, your team can temporarily finish them before returning to the selected focus target.
